title: Input and output
description:
Write a program that reads a name and a birth year (one per line), then greets the person and says how old they turn in 2026:

```
Name? Ada
Birth year? 1990
Hello, Ada!
In 2026 you turn 36.
```

Print the prompts with `print!` (no line break), read each answer with `read_line`, and trim it. Parse the year with `parse::<i32>()`.
hints: `print!` does not flush the output by itself; `io::stdout().flush().unwrap()` makes the prompt appear before the program waits for input (needs `use std::io::Write`).
`read_line` keeps the line break: `name.trim()` removes it.

examples.name: Ada
examples.expected:
Name? Birth year? Hello, Ada!
In 2026 you turn 36.

examples.name: a two-word name
examples.expected:
Name? Birth year? Hello, Grace Hopper!
In 2026 you turn 16.
